summary: The change does what the request asked. OLY-B-STD-03 in docs/spec.toml now names a mechanism: a new test, crates/athena-core/tests/buy_first.rs. The test reads the real root Cargo.toml with toml_edit and the real docs/decisions.md. It checks that every external crate under [workspace.dependencies] is named, in backticks, in the Decision bullet of a "Buy before build" entry. The owner is still Athena, and the measure ends `status: not shown` and names the test command. Three crates (proc-macro2, syn, toml_edit) were in Cargo.toml with no recorded decision. A new entry, D173, now records them and the need each one meets. I checked those needs against the code: syn is used in code_health.rs and design_surface.rs, and toml_edit in toolconfig.rs, iris.rs and others. Cargo.toml and crates/athena-core/Cargo.toml are unchanged. In the snapshot, all 12 buy_first tests pass, as do the xtask spec test (30 tests) and the xtask ci_shards test (20 tests). Athena's own runs with the fix reverted show the real-file, stray-crate, alternative-only and spec-entry tests failing. The fmt, clippy and test checks come from CI and passed. The only finding is minor scope: xtask/shard-timings.txt changed but is not on the expected deliverables list. That change was planned and is required by the ci_shards coverage test.
